body: Ruling on BUG-2626: (a) no bindings heal on the primary with the unreviewed binary now; (b) no live tick (reap_quiet acts on real sessions). Your dry-run evidence is accepted as AC1's pre-merge evidence; AC1 stays open for post-landing cron. Required landing step: after the promotion lands and dev build promotes, the advisor runs the one-time bindings heal via the script deputy, no train running, before the next cron tick. Add that step and the exact heal command to the #4165 body (and later p17), then ping me for the --rereview.
